name: Gershom
bio: Gershom is the firstborn son of Moses and Zipporah. Moses named him saying, "I have been a stranger in a strange land," and so called him "Gershom," meaning "a sojourner there," reflecting Moses' own sense of exile as a refugee in Midian (Exodus 2:22). Gershom's descendants are later recorded in 1 Chronicles, becoming a branch of the Levite clan of Gershon.
